other_conditions: The baker must be registered with the All Goa Bakers Association under the Societies Registration Act, 1860
The baker (or his/her family) must have been engaged in the business of making traditional Goan breads for at least the last 20 years
The baker must be a Goan resident by birth
The baker must be recommended by the All Goa Bakers Association
The baker must produce and sell Pao, Undho, Poie, Kakon or similar traditional breads
benefits_summary: Provides a cash subsidy on maida purchases up to 150 kg per day, with ₹4 per kg for the first 50 kg and lower rates for higher usage.
documents_required: Affidavit declaring the contents of the application as true
Bills of purchase of maida for the relevant quarter
